rules: :root { --color-pink: #fbdddd; --color-black: #231f20; --color-white: #fff; --color-success: #146e14; --color-error: #e73232; --color-warning: #f1c45b; --color-disabled: #5c5c5c; --font-header: "F37 Judge",sans-serif; --font-header-alt: "obviously",sans-serif; --font-body: "Space Grotesk",sans-serif; --min-title-size: 3.875rem; --max-title-size: 6.25rem; --ideal-title-size: 6vw; --title-size: clamp(var(--min-title-size),var(--ideal-title-size),var(--max-title-size)); --bg-color: var(--color-pink); --text-color: var(--color-black); --border-width: 2px; --container-max-width: 1600px; --body-padding: .5rem; --border-radius: .5rem; --border-default: calc(var(--border-width)/2)solid var(--color-black); --border-default-thick: var(--border-width)solid var(--color-black); --transition-speed: .25s; --transition-easing: ease-out; font-size: 16px; }
